shadows.name: paper-lift
shadows.purpose: Lift the letter and ticket from the page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Deep rose action with a tactile press and calm glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#6e3547; color:#f6f2ed; padding:16px 32px; border:0; border-radius:9999px; font:700 0.7rem/1.2 'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),box-shadow .22s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 0 32px -12px rgba(163,78,93,.7); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #a34e5d; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Paper-outline secondary action for the playful No path.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background:#fcfbf7; color:#6e3547; padding:12px 24px; border:1px solid #d69a99; border-radius:9999px; font:700 0.7rem/1.2 'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; transition:background .22s,transform .22s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#f0e7e2; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #a34e5d; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Floating Navigation
components.description: Minimal recipient rail with music and journey progress.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:20px; padding:10px 20px; background:rgba(252,251,247,.86); color:#332c2f; border-radius:9999px; box-shadow:0 18px 50px -24px rgba(82,44,50,.34); font:600 1rem/1.4 'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif; } .ds-nav button { min-height:44px; padding:8px 14px; border:0; border-radius:9999px; background:#f0e7e2; color:#6e3547; font:700 .7rem/1.2 'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #a34e5d; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Paper Letter
components.description: Layered stationery surface for the staged invitation copy.
components.html:
For you, Sassy

I made a little day for us.
components.css: .ds-letter { position:relative; padding:40px; background:#fcfbf7; color:#332c2f; border:1px solid #e3c9c4; border-radius:12px; box-shadow:0 18px 38px -14px rgba(96,52,57,.28); font:400 1rem/1.7 'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-letter h2 { margin:0 0 20px; color:#6e3547; font:700 clamp(2.5rem,8vw,5rem)/1.05 'Dancing Script',cursive; }

components.name: Date Ticket
components.description: A calm, printable keepsake that repeats the invitation material language.
components.css: .ds-ticket { padding:32px; background:#fcfbf7; color:#332c2f; border:1px solid #e3c9c4; border-radius:16px; box-shadow:0 24px 50px -16px rgba(96,52,57,.3); } .ds-ticket span { color:#6e3547; font:700 .7rem/1.2 'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-ticket strong { display:block; margin-top:12px; font:700 1.5rem/1.2 'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif; }

narrative.overview: This experience should feel like a personal letter discovered in a quiet room after sunset. The invitation is intimate before it is impressive. Paper, ink, soft shadow, and a small amount of atmosphere make the recipient feel that the whole journey was prepared for one person.
keyCharacteristics: Personal stationery with visible paper layering.
Deep rose actions against an ivory field.
Muted violet used as atmosphere, not decoration everywhere.
Tactile controls with clear pressed and focused states.
Motion that builds anticipation, then settles gently.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Rose is the emotional signal. Violet supports depth, but must not compete with the primary action on the same surface.

rules.name: The Letter Rule
rules.body: Let the handwriting and serif carry personality. Never use display type for long instructions or date metadata.

rules.name: The Quiet Field Rule
rules.body: Most of the screen should remain calm so the current scene has somewhere to breathe.

dos: Do make the recipient's name and the handwritten greeting the first emotional signal.
Do use warm ivory, deep rose ink, and dusk violet consistently.
Do keep body copy readable with generous line-height and short measure.
Do use paper layering, rules, and shadow to explain depth.
Do preserve keyboard focus, 44px touch targets, reduced motion, and contrast.
Do let each scene have one visual hero instead of many competing cards.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS dashboards, neon AI gradients, or interchangeable landing-page templates.
Don't use dense card grids, game-like confetti, or childish sticker collages.
Don't make decorative glass surfaces the default treatment.
Don't use gradient text, thick colored side stripes, or wide black shadows.
Don't repeat tiny uppercase eyebrows above every section.
Don't let violet compete with the rose action on the same surface.
